samplePrompts.p01: What is the maximum probation period under Saudi Labor Law?
samplePrompts.p02: How is end-of-service award calculated for a resigning employee?
samplePrompts.p03: When must overtime be paid, and at what rate in KSA?
samplePrompts.p04: What are the weekly working hour limits under Saudi Labor Law?
samplePrompts.p05: How much notice is required to terminate an indefinite contract?
samplePrompts.p06: What documents are needed for a fixed-term employment contract?
samplePrompts.p07: Can an employer deduct from wages for damages, and by how much?

samplePrompts.p09: What are the rules for unpaid leave under Saudi Labor Law?
samplePrompts.p10: When can an employer dismiss an employee without notice?

samplePrompts.p17: How should we classify a contractor vs an employee for HRSD?

samplePrompts.p22: How is Zakat calculated for a Saudi resident company?
samplePrompts.p23: What is the difference between a simplified and a standard tax invoice?

samplePrompts.p25: What happens if we miss a ZATCA VAT return filing deadline?

experts.platformExpertsHint: Experts provided by Geem and available to this workspace.
experts.noExpertsHint: Create your first Expert to get started.

geemGeneral.name: Geem General Assistant
geemGeneral.description: General Geem assistant. Answers without workspace knowledge documents.

experts.loadErrorHint: Check your connection and try again.
experts.createDescription: Set up a Workspace Expert. You can add knowledge after creating it.
experts.name: Name
experts.instructionsPlaceholder: How should this Expert answer and behave?
experts.instructionsHint: These instructions define how the Expert should answer and behave. Maximum length is enforced by the server.
experts.advancedSettingsHint: Controls how this Expert finds passages in its knowledge before answering.
experts.topKHint: How many knowledge passages to retrieve from this Expert’s documents before reranking. Higher values search more broadly but may add noise (1–100).
experts.rerankTopNHint: How many of those passages to keep after reranking. Only these are sent to the Expert as context (1–50).
experts.similarityThresholdHint: Minimum similarity score for a passage to be included. Lower values allow looser matches (0–1).
experts.knowledgeEmptyHint: Add knowledge to make this Expert ready.
experts.titleOptional: Optional — derived from filename if blank.
experts.reused: This document already exists in the Workspace and has been added to this Expert.
experts.processingHint: Parsing and indexing this file. You can close this and keep working.
experts.processingFailed: Processing failed. You can reprocess from the knowledge list.
experts.reprocessConfirm: Reprocess this document? Status will update from the server.
experts.removeHint: This removes the document from this Expert only. Other Experts that use the same document keep their access. The Workspace document is not deleted.
experts.deleteHint: Deleting the Expert removes its configuration. Underlying Workspace documents are not deleted automatically.
experts.platformManaged: Knowledge for this Platform Expert is managed by Geem.
experts.platformRedirect: Platform Experts cannot be edited here.
experts.apiIdHint: Send this UUID in the X-Geem-Expert-Id header when calling POST /api/v1/chat/completions.
